mcMechanic: Scarlet raycast (~16 blocks). On a player, force-unequip the main-hand item and eject it as a dropped ItemEntity flung toward the caster (set velocity toward caster); on a mob, strip its main-hand item the same way. Apply small knockback away from caster, deal 1 heart, and apply Weakness I for 40 ticks. Fizzles with a softer sound if the slot is empty/locked.
turkishDesc: Silahsizlandirma buyusu: hedefin elindeki esyayi cikarip buyucuye dogru firlatir ve onu geriye iter.

mcMechanic: Short-range red raycast bolt; first entity hit gets Slowness V + Weakness II for 60 ticks, Glowing 60 ticks, and ~1.5 hearts magic damage. Mob AI is suspended (no-AI/stunned) for the duration to simulate being knocked out. Players get screen shake and a brief mining-fatigue equivalent. No knockback so the target falls where it stands.
turkishDesc: Sersemletme buyusu: hedefi bayiltarak oldugu yerde hareketsiz birakir; ucuz ama dusuk hasarli kontrol buyusu.

mcMechanic: Blue raycast. Target receives Slowness X (full root) + Mining Fatigue III + jump-prevention for 100 ticks; mobs have AI disabled so they stand/fall frozen. Apply Glowing so the bound target is visible. No damage, pure hard crowd control; target cannot attack or break blocks. Ends with a release chime.
turkishDesc: Tam vucut baglama lanetini: hedefi tepeden tirnaga dondurarak hareketsiz birakir; hasar vermez, saf kontrol saglar.

mcMechanic: Short-range flamethrower cone/raycast (~6-12 blocks). Continuously emits FLAME + SMOKE; any LivingEntity in the cone is ignited (setOnFireFor ~4-5s) and takes ~2 fire/magic damage. If the ray hits a flammable block face, place a fire block like Flint & Steel (respect fire gamerule). Cheap entry-level fire spell and counter to Glacius.
turkishDesc: Ates yapma buyusu: asadan alev fiskirtir, hedefi tutusturur ve yanici bloklari atesler; hem saldiri hem aydinlatma araci.

mcMechanic: Raycast up to 12 blocks. Apply Slowness III for 5s and Mining Fatigue I for 3s to the hit entity and extinguish any fire on it. If the ray hits a water source block, convert it to ice. Mobs vulnerable to freezing take 2 extra damage. Spawns SNOWFLAKE particles. Direct counter to Incendio. Found as a book.
turkishDesc: Dondurma buyusu: hedefi yavaslatir, atesini sonderur ve su bloklarini buza cevirir; Incendio'nun dogal karsiti.

mcMechanic: Raycast up to 10 blocks. Extinguishes fire on the targeted entity and any fire blocks along the path like a water bucket splash. Slight knockback (~0.4 velocity), no direct damage; turns lava into cobblestone on contact. On the ground it places a temporary water source that evaporates after 200 ticks. Emits FALLING_WATER + SPLASH.
turkishDesc: Su yapma buyusu: asadan temiz su fiskirtir, atesleri sonderur ve gecici su kaynagi olusturur; Incendio yanginlarinin karsiti.

mcMechanic: Raycast ~12 blocks. On an entity apply Levitation I for 60 ticks and zero its fall damage; if aimed at a falling-eligible block, spawn it as a FallingBlockEntity with upward velocity. While held the entity tracks the crosshair (velocity toward look vector); releasing drops it gently (negate fall damage 2s). Cap lifted-entity mass (no raid bosses).
turkishDesc: Havalandirma buyusu: nesneleri ve yaratiklari havaya kaldirip nisangaha gore tasir; dusme hasarini engeller.

mcMechanic: Toggle on. Places an invisible light_block (level 15) at the player's position each tick while active, or simplest impl grants ambient Night Vision for 600 ticks (refreshed before expiry to avoid the vanilla blue flash) plus a faint wand-tip glow particle. Toggling off invokes the Nox counter-charm to remove the light and clear the effect. Trivial mana to stay lit while exploring.
turkishDesc: Isik buyusu: asanin ucundan isik yayar ve karanlik alanlari aydinlatir; Nox ile sonderulur.

mcMechanic: Self-buff for 100 ticks: apply Resistance III (blocks ~80% of incoming damage) and fully negate incoming projectiles/spell-projectiles, reflecting them back along inverse velocity. Render a translucent dome particle ring. Breaks early if absorbed damage exceeds ~20. Tuned so it can't be perma-held.
turkishDesc: Kalkan buyusu: gelen buyu ve saldirilari engelleyen gorunmez bir bariyer kurar ve mermileri geri yansitir.

mcMechanic: Raycast/AoE up to 16 blocks. Target the looked-at ItemEntity or pull all dropped ItemEntities within an 8-block cone, setting their velocity toward the player (item magnet). Can also yank a non-boss mob by setting its velocity strongly toward the caster (drag an enemy into melee or off a ledge). Excludes items inside containers to avoid dupes.
turkishDesc: Cagirma buyusu: uzaktaki esyalari ve kucuk yaratiklari buyucuye dogru ceker; hem toplama hem taktiksel cekme araci.

mcMechanic: Raycast disintegrate beam (~24 blocks). At the impact point break a small sphere (radius ~2) of non-blast-resistant blocks WITHOUT dropping items (setBlockState to AIR); obsidian/bedrock/reinforced are immune. Against entities deal ~3 hearts magic damage with light knockback. Spawns EXPLOSION particles but no fire and no terrain ignition. Respect block protection/claims.
turkishDesc: Parcalama laneti: onundeki bloklari toz haline getirir ve hedeflere hasar verir; atessiz, blok odakli yikim buyusu.

mcMechanic: Lobbed projectile that detonates on impact: world.createExplosion(caster, x, y, z, power ~2.5f, destructionType=DESTROY) with NO fire. Damages and knocks back nearby entities (AoE radius ~3) and breaks weak blocks. Functions like an aimed mini-TNT but instant (no fuse) and weaker than vanilla TNT. The arc distinguishes it from hitscan Reducto. Honor block protections.
turkishDesc: Patlatma buyusu: firlatilan ve carptigi yerde kontrollu bir patlama yaratan mermi; kapilari ve engelleri parcalar.

mcMechanic: Self-cast minor heal: applies Regeneration I for 100 ticks AND instantly restores ~4 hearts via heal(8.0f). Best used out of combat for quick patch-ups. Spawns HEART particles. Low cooldown so it can top off health, but the flat heal is small enough that it cannot out-sustain real combat damage.
turkishDesc: Iyilestirme buyusu: kucuk yaralari ve kirilmalari onarir; en ucuz ilk yardim buyusu, sinirli can yeniler.

mcMechanic: Summons a temporary luminous guardian (glowing invulnerable Allay/wolf-analog or pure-particle entity) for 200 ticks. It emits radius-8 light and applies Regeneration I to nearby allies; hostile undead (zombies, skeletons) or custom Dementors within 6 blocks are repelled with knockback and take 4.0 radiant damage/sec. Caster gains short Absorption on cast. Found as a book.
turkishDesc: Patronus buyusu: pozitif enerjiden parlayan bir koruyucu cagirir; mufettisleri ve olusuzleri kovar, muttefiklere can verir.

mcMechanic: Raycast invisible slash (~16 blocks). On hit: ~3.5 hearts slashing damage that bypasses some armor PLUS a stacking custom 'bleeding' DoT dealing 1 heart every 20 ticks for ~8s and suppressing natural regen (also apply Weakness). Bleed can be cleared early by a healing spell or regen potion, mirroring the canon counter-curse. Flags the caster with dark-magic notoriety.
turkishDesc: Snape'in karanlik laneti: gorunmez bir kilic gibi derin kesikler acar ve durmayan kanama hasari verir; iyilestirme ile durdurulabilir.

mcMechanic: SLYTHERIN-MINE REWARD (found as a torn page/dark tome in a Slytherin mine/dungeon). Channeled single-target raycast pain lock (~20 blocks). On hit, apply a stacked debuff package for ~5s: Slowness IV, Weakness II, Mining Fatigue III, and Nausea, plus periodic low magic damage (1 heart every 20 ticks via a non-lethal DamageSource, capped so HP cannot drop below ~1). While the caster holds use, reapply each tick and emit DAMAGE_INDICATOR particles. Flags caster with notoriety.
turkishDesc: Cruciatus laneti: hedefe dayanilmaz aci cektiren kanalize karanlik buyu; Slytherin madeninden odul olarak bulunur, oldurmez ama felc eder.

mcMechanic: EXTREME-COST UNFORGIVABLE. Single-target instant raycast (~32 blocks, blocked by line-of-sight). On hit the target LivingEntity is killed outright via a custom DamageType that bypasses armor, enchantments and absorption (bypasses_invulnerability/bypasses_armor tags). The ONLY mitigation is a custom 'love_protection' status which reflects the kill back. Drains the ENTIRE mana pool (20/20), long cooldown, and flags the caster with a persistent notoriety/'Azkaban' tag. Against bosses, deal massive magic damage instead of true-kill. Green WITCH particle trail with a thunder boom on impact.
turkishDesc: Oldurme laneti: aniden ve karsi konulamaz sekilde olum getiren bagislanmaz buyu; tum manayi tuketir, uzun bekleme suresi vardir ve sadece fedakarlik korumasiyla engellenir.
